create_llama_tokenizer: create a LlamaTokenizer instance from a pretrained model checkpoint for byte-level BPE tokenization
encode_text_with_llama_tokenizer: encode a text string into token IDs using the LlamaTokenizer with BOS and EOS token handling
decode_tokens_with_llama_tokenizer: decode a list of token IDs back into a text string using the LlamaTokenizer decoder pipeline
configure_llama_system_prompt: configure the LlamaTokenizer to use the default system prompt with B_INST, E_INST, B_SYS, and E_SYS markers
build_llama_tokenizer_with_custom_vocab: build a LlamaTokenizer with a custom vocabulary dictionary, merges list, and prefix space settings
